title: Rumble and the Brand-New Baby
summary: A little blue dragon can't wait to show his brand-new baby sister his biggest flying tricks, and learns that being gentle, patient and helpful is the best big-brother trick of all.
character: Rumble, a small chubby young dragon with sky-blue scales, a pale cream belly, two little rounded golden horns, small teal wings, big round amber eyes and a short curly tail

cover.scene: Rumble proudly and gently curls around the round straw nest at the mouth of the cave, the tiny pink baby dragon snuggled in the nest smiling up at him, a fairy-tale castle and soft clouds far below the cliff, warm golden morning light, heroic and tender. pages.text: High on a mountain cliff, above a sleepy castle and the fluffy clouds, a little blue dragon named Rumble lived in a cozy cave with Mama and Papa. One golden morning, the speckled egg in their nest began to wiggle. Crack, crack, crick! Out popped a tiny pink baby dragon with a sleepy little yawn.
pages.scene: At the wide mouth of a cozy cave high on a mountain cliff, with a round nest of soft straw and moss on the stone floor: Mama Dragon and Papa Dragon and Rumble lean over the nest as the baby dragon pokes out of a cracked speckled egg, yawning; bits of eggshell around her. Other characters (only when named in this scene): the baby dragon, a tiny round hatchling with soft peach-pink scales, a cream belly, stubby little wings and sleepy violet eyes; Mama Dragon, a big gentle dragon with deep green scales, a cream belly and kind golden eyes; Papa Dragon, a big friendly dragon with warm orange scales, a cream belly and kind brown eyes

pages.text: "My baby sister!" Rumble gasped, bouncing on his tail. "I'm going to show you everything! The big wide sky, my loop-de-loops, and my super-speedy zoom!" He flapped so hard that a big gust of wind ruffled the whole nest. The baby squeaked and hid under Mama's warm wing.
pages.scene: At the wide mouth of a cozy cave high on a mountain cliff, with a round nest of soft straw and moss on the stone floor: Rumble flaps his wings excitedly beside the nest, straw blowing about; the baby dragon peeks out from under Mama Dragon's wing. Other characters (only when named in this scene): the baby dragon, a tiny round hatchling with soft peach-pink scales, a cream belly, stubby little wings and sleepy violet eyes; Mama Dragon, a big gentle dragon with deep green scales, a cream belly and kind golden eyes; Papa Dragon, a big friendly dragon with warm orange scales, a cream belly and kind brown eyes

pages.text: "Gently, my brave one," Mama said with a smile. "Your sister is brand new. Her wings are still soft and wobbly, like little leaves." Rumble looked at his own strong wings, and then at the tiny baby. He wanted to share his whole wonderful world with her, right this very minute.
pages.scene: Inside the cozy cave beside the nest: Mama Dragon holds the baby dragon gently while Rumble leans in close, looking at the baby's tiny wings. pages.background: plain smooth sandy cave wall and ceiling washed in warm light

pages.text: So Rumble tried a trick. He swooped out of the cave, twirled a loop around the castle towers, and landed with a mighty THUMP! "Ta-da!" he shouted. But the baby didn't clap. She just blinked her sleepy violet eyes and snuggled closer to Papa.
pages.scene: Wide view: a small fairy-tale castle with round towers sits low in the picture below the mountain cliff; Rumble, small in the picture, swoops in a happy loop around the lowest tower; far off at the cliff-edge cave Papa Dragon holds the baby dragon. pages.text: Mama and Papa were very busy with the baby. They fed her, rocked her, and sang to her. "Just a minute, Rumble," said Papa, again and again. Rumble sat at the edge of the cave and watched the clouds drift by below. He felt a tiny bit left out.
pages.scene: At the wide mouth of a cozy cave high on a mountain cliff, with a round nest of soft straw and moss on the stone floor: Rumble sits at the cliff edge with his chin in his paws, looking out at soft clouds far below; behind him Mama Dragon and Papa Dragon rock the baby dragon in the nest. Other characters (only when named in this scene): the baby dragon, a tiny round hatchling with soft peach-pink scales, a cream belly, stubby little wings and sleepy violet eyes; Mama Dragon, a big gentle dragon with deep green scales, a cream belly and kind golden eyes; Papa Dragon, a big friendly dragon with warm orange scales, a cream belly and kind brown eyes

pages.text: Then Papa came and sat beside him. "Do you remember learning to fly?" Papa asked. "It took a long, slow time. Your sister will need a patient big brother to help her grow strong." Rumble's eyes went wide. "A patient big brother? I can be that!"
pages.scene: At the cliff edge outside the cave: Papa Dragon sits beside Rumble with one big wing around him; Rumble looks up at him with wide hopeful eyes; small clouds and a distant castle far below. Other characters (only when named in this scene): the baby dragon, a tiny round hatchling with soft peach-pink scales, a cream belly, stubby little wings and sleepy violet eyes; Mama Dragon, a big gentle dragon with deep green scales, a cream belly and kind golden eyes; Papa Dragon, a big friendly dragon with warm orange scales, a cream belly and kind brown eyes

pages.text: That evening, a chilly breeze crept into the cave. Rumble had an idea. He took a deep breath and puffed a soft, warm breeze all around the nest. Hoo, hoo, hoo! The baby wiggled and chirped. "You warmed her right up!" said Mama, and Rumble felt proud all the way to his tail.
pages.scene: Inside the cozy cave in the evening: Rumble gently puffs a soft swirl of warm golden air (no fire) around the nest where the baby dragon wiggles happily; Mama Dragon watches smiling. pages.background: plain smooth cave wall and ceiling in soft warm amber evening light

pages.text: Next, the baby began to fuss. "Wah! Wah!" Rumble remembered the song Mama used to hum for him. Very softly, he hummed, "Hmm-mm, hmm-mm, the clouds are drifting by." The baby's eyes grew heavy, and her tiny tail curled up like a sleepy snail.
pages.scene: Inside the cozy cave: Rumble leans over the nest humming softly with his eyes half closed, a few tiny musical notes floating low; the baby dragon is falling asleep with her tail curled. pages.text: The next morning, Rumble didn't zoom or shout. He tiptoed close and showed the baby small, gentle treasures: a smooth shiny pebble, a soft white feather, and a little purple flower. The baby sniffed each one with her nose. Then she gave Rumble the biggest, gummiest smile.
pages.scene: At the wide mouth of a cozy cave high on a mountain cliff, with a round nest of soft straw and moss on the stone floor in the morning: Rumble lies on his belly beside the nest showing the baby dragon a shiny pebble, a white feather and a small purple flower laid out on the stone; the baby dragon smiles a big gummy smile. pages.text: That afternoon, Mama opened her wings wide. "There is room for two," she said, and she wrapped one wing around the baby and the other around Rumble. Rumble learned something wonderful. Love doesn't get smaller when you share it. It just stretches bigger, like the sky.
pages.scene: At the mouth of the cozy cave: Mama Dragon sits with both wings wrapped in a hug, the baby dragon snuggled under one wing and Rumble under the other, all smiling. Other characters (only when named in this scene): the baby dragon, a tiny round hatchling with soft peach-pink scales, a cream belly, stubby little wings and sleepy violet eyes; Mama Dragon, a big gentle dragon with deep green scales, a cream belly and kind golden eyes; Papa Dragon, a big friendly dragon with warm orange scales, a cream belly and kind brown eyes

pages.text: At sunset, Papa carried the baby safely on his back, and Rumble flew slowly beside them. No zooming, just a gentle glide over the castle and the pink clouds. "Look, little sister," Rumble whispered. "That's the big wide sky. Someday we'll fly it together."
pages.scene: Wide view: Papa Dragon glides slowly with the baby dragon riding safely on his back, Rumble gliding gently beside them, all small in the lower part of the picture just above soft pink clouds and a tiny distant castle. pages.text: Back in the cozy cave, the stars came out one by one. Rumble puffed a warm breeze around the nest and hummed the cloud song once more. The baby yawned a tiny yawn. Then Rumble yawned a great big one.
pages.scene: At the mouth of the cozy cave at night: Rumble curls beside the nest yawning a big yawn while the baby dragon yawns a tiny yawn; a few faint stars. pages.text: Mama and Papa tucked them in, side by side. "We're so proud of you, our gentle big brother," Papa whispered. Rumble smiled a sleepy smile. Being a big brother, he thought, is the very best trick of all. Goodnight, little dragons.
pages.scene: Inside the cozy cave at night: Rumble and the baby dragon sleep side by side in the soft nest; Mama Dragon and Papa Dragon curl protectively around them, eyes closed and smiling; warm soft glow. end.text: The end. Sweet dreams, big brother!
